paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是一些自以为已经很了解家人的人，慢慢发现自己可能太早下了判断。

菲尔想和岳父杰建立更亲近的关系。他告诉克莱尔，自己和杰是很好的朋友，但克莱尔指出，他们都结婚十六年了，菲尔在杰面前还是会紧张。

菲尔去看杰时，杰正在做一架模型飞机，明显只想一个人待着。菲尔却一直想加入，杰最后只好带他去一块空地放飞机。菲尔非常兴奋，希望这会成为两个人真正拉近关系的机会。

一开始，一切似乎进行得不错。后来，杰让菲尔站到远处，举起一个圆环，好让他把飞机从环里穿过去。结果，杰却直接把飞机撞到了菲尔脸上。他说这只是意外，但克莱尔太了解自己的父亲了，逼着他承认真相。

杰解释说，菲尔总是太过用力地讨好他，这让他很烦。克莱尔告诉杰，菲尔之所以这样，是因为杰从来没有主动为这段关系付出过努力。杰最后向菲尔道歉，还告诉他自己其实喜欢他。他甚至说菲尔是个好父亲，这对菲尔来说意义很大。

与此同时，克莱尔正在和小女儿亚历克斯争论她参加婚礼时该穿什么。克莱尔想让她穿裙子，但亚历克斯不想打扮得像海莉。她觉得克莱尔根本不理解自己。

格洛丽亚带亚历克斯去购物，和她聊天时更像朋友，而不是家长。亚历克斯最后承认，她觉得自己不像海莉和克莱尔那么漂亮。她一直把自己看成家里“聪明的那个”。格洛丽亚指出，餐厅里有个可爱的男孩一直在看她，这让亚历克斯多了一点自信。

她们外出时，曼尼留在克莱尔家。他提醒克莱尔，亚历克斯可能只是想拥有自己的特点，而不是一直和海莉比较。于是克莱尔决定不再强迫她穿裙子。不过到了这时，亚历克斯已经自己决定买一条裙子了。

米切尔和卡梅隆遇到的问题轻松得多。他们去好市多买尿布，但米切尔看不起这家店，只想尽快离开。随后，他发现了便宜的酒、各种食物、电子产品，还有所有东西的超大包装。

没过几分钟，米切尔就彻底爱上了这里，开始往好几辆购物车里塞他们根本不需要的东西。卡梅隆只能看着米切尔变成一个比自己还狂热的好市多爱好者。

到了最后，杰开始主动靠近菲尔，克莱尔给了亚历克斯更多空间，米切尔也承认自己对好市多的看法错了。没有人彻底改变，但他们都比以前多理解了对方一点。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about family members who think they already understand one another, but slowly realize they may have judged too quickly.

Phil wants to have a closer relationship with Jay, his father-in-law. He tells Claire that he and Jay are good friends, but Claire points out that after sixteen years of marriage, Phil still acts nervous around him.

When Phil visits Jay, Jay is working on a model airplane and clearly wants to be left alone. Phil keeps trying to join in, so Jay finally takes him to a field to fly it. Phil is excited and hopes this will be their chance to connect.

At first, things seem to be going well. Then Jay asks Phil to stand far away and hold up a hoop so he can fly the plane through it. Instead, Jay flies the plane straight into Phil’s face. He says it was an accident, but Claire knows her father too well and makes him admit the truth.

Jay explains that Phil tries too hard, which gets on his nerves. Claire tells him that Phil only does that because Jay never makes any effort with him. Jay finally apologizes and tells Phil that he likes him. He even says Phil is a good dad, which means a lot to him.

Meanwhile, Claire is arguing with her younger daughter, Alex, about what she should wear to a wedding. Claire wants her to wear a dress, but Alex doesn’t want to look like Haley. She feels that Claire doesn’t understand her at all.

Gloria takes Alex shopping and talks to her more like a friend than a parent. Alex eventually admits that she doesn’t think she’s pretty like Haley and Claire. She sees herself as “the smart one.” Gloria points out that a cute boy at the restaurant has been looking at her, which gives Alex a little more confidence.

While they’re out, Manny stays at Claire’s house. He suggests that Alex may simply be trying to have her own identity instead of competing with Haley. Claire decides not to force the dress issue. By then, however, Alex has chosen to buy one herself.

Mitchell and Cameron have a much lighter problem. They go to Costco to buy diapers, but Mitchell looks down on the store and wants to leave as quickly as possible. Then he discovers the cheap wine, the food, the electronics, and the huge packs of everything.

Within minutes, Mitchell is completely in love with the place and starts filling several carts with things they don’t need. Cameron can only watch as Mitchell becomes a bigger Costco fan than he is.

By the end, Jay makes an effort with Phil, Claire gives Alex more room, and Mitchell admits he was wrong about Costco. Nobody changes completely, but they all understand one another a little better.
